language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: This applies to the installer interface and to the language of the installed system.

disk.title: Choose the disk
disk.subtitle: The system will be installed on this disk.
disk.warningBody: The selected disk will be completely reset: its partition table will be replaced and everything on it will be permanently lost. This cannot be undone.
disk.confirmLabel: I understand that {disk} will be completely erased
disk.noDiskHint: Check that the disk is connected, then start the installer again.
disk.layoutRoot: btrfs root filling the rest of the disk
disk.swapHint: Enables hibernation. The system boots fine without it.
disk.tooSmall: This disk is too small to hold the system.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.subtitle: Click your location on the map, or search for your city.
timezone.search: Search for a city or region…

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: This account will be the administrator of the machine.
account.fullNameHint: Shown on the login screen and in applications.
account.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dash and underscore. Must start with a letter.
account.hostnameHint: The name this machine will appear under on the network.
account.requireStrongHint: Rejects passwords that are short, common, or built from your name.
account.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

error.usernameIllegal: Illegal characters: only unaccented lowercase letters, digits, dash and underscore — and the first character must be a letter or an underscore.
error.hostnameIllegal: Invalid machine name: letters, digits and dashes only, with no dash at either end.

desktop.title: Desktop environment
desktop.subtitle: You can install something else later; this is the starting point.
desktop.gnomeDesc: Sober and touch-friendly, tightly integrated. Closest to a modern operating system.
desktop.plasmaDesc: The most customisable. Familiar to anyone coming from Windows.
desktop.cinnamonDesc: Traditional and stable. Panel at the bottom, menu on the left.
desktop.budgieDesc: Clean and focused on simplicity, without an excess of options.

options.title: Options
options.subtitle: Everything here is optional and can be changed after installation.
options.drivers: Drivers and codecs that will be installed
options.nvidiaOpen: NVIDIA open kernel modules — Turing or newer card.
options.nvidiaLegacy: NVIDIA card older than Turing. Choose the matching branch:
options.nvidiaLegacyNone: No branch selected: no proprietary driver will be installed.
options.nvidiaWarning: Choosing the wrong branch leaves the machine with no display. If unsure, leave this empty and install the driver after the first boot.
options.aurHint: Installs yay and the btrfs snapshot tooling. Requires a network connection.
options.shellyHint: Alternative package manager, with a graphical interface and AUR support.
options.networkRequired: AUR support requires a network connection.
options.kernelHint: The kernel drives the hardware and the scheduler. It can be changed after installation, but not without rebooting.

kernel.linuxDesc: Arch's rolling kernel. Newest drivers and features.
kernel.ltsDesc: Long-term support. Older, far more stable — the safe choice.
kernel.zenDesc: Tuned for desktop responsiveness and gaming. Slightly less power-efficient.

options.virtualMachine: Virtual machine detected: the display is a paravirtual device, so no vendor driver is needed.

summary.title: Summary
summary.subtitle: One last check before the installation starts.
summary.warning: The installation will erase {disk} and write a new system. This cannot be undone.

install.title: Installing
install.subtitle: Do not power off the machine or remove the installation medium.
install.doneBody: You can now reboot into the installed system.
install.failedBody: Nothing was left in an inconsistent state: the target disk has been unmounted.

keyboard.title: Keyboard layout
keyboard.subtitle: Preselected from your time zone. Check it by typing below.
keyboard.testPlaceholder: Type a few characters, for example @ # / \ { } [ ]
keyboard.appliedHint: The layout is applied immediately: the graphical session restarts, then returns here.

network.title: Network connection
network.subtitle: Wired connections are detected automatically. Nothing to do if a cable is plugged in.
network.stateOnlineDetail: All good. Packages and AUR tools can be downloaded.
network.stateLinkOnlyDetail: An interface has an address, but the internet does not answer. Check the cable or the router.
network.stateOfflineDetail: That is not a problem: the installation works perfectly well without a network.
network.wiredHint: If a cable is plugged in, the address arrives within seconds. Nothing to type.
network.noNetwork: No network found. Move closer to the router, or try again.
network.noWifi: This machine has no wireless interface.
network.trouble: The connection did not go through
network.optional: You can carry on without a network. Only the AUR tools need one, and they are optional.
